# Upstream attribution

`docker-compose.upstream.yaml` and `LICENSE` copied from Penpot tag 2.18.3:
https://github.com/penpot/penpot/tree/2.18.3
Retrieved 8 October 2026. MPL-2.0.

Root `compose.yaml` is derived from that configuration: version pinned,

private service ports, Sigma gateway and Caddy added.
